evidence: Modifies core utility primitive CBloomFilter in src/common/bloom.cpp and src/common/bloom.h.
rationale: Fixes potential division by zero and undefined floating-point conversion in the CBloomFilter utility constructor. The problem notes that the constructor 'divides by zero when given zero elements and causes undefined behavior when converting out-of-range floating-point results to unsigned int', primarily impacting unit tests and fuzzing.
